methodology: User-supplied scenarios. Greeting first name replaced by fictional Noor; no private screenshot values. Each case has an isolated session; turns within it share server memory.

cases.title: UAEU STEM programs
turns: Can you tell me all STEM programs UAEU offers?
cases.expected: Group the published undergraduate STEM programs by their official colleges, or provide specific college program directory links. Define the requested degree level and avoid calling minors standalone degrees.

cases.title: Ambiguous CE followed by Computer Engineering
turns: Does UAEU have a CE program?
cases.expected: Clarify Civil versus Computer Engineering first; then identify the current Computer and Artificial Intelligence Engineering degree, explain its two concentrations or general pathway, and give readable current sources.

cases.title: Calendar then Mechanical Engineering project then chat history and identity
turns: Where can I check UAEU academic calendar deadlines?
I am a mech E student in my third year first semester, when should I take the senior project?
No, I am a mechanical engineering student, not whatever that is!
cases.expected: Calendar source; Mechanical Engineering project sequence from the applicable model (ask entry cohort if needed), never VMED580; preserve the correction; recall the first calendar question from chat; identify the student SGP team from CCAI without retrieving a university policy.

cases.title: First-year introduction without a question
turns: Hi, my name is Noor. I am an IT major in my first year, first semester at UAEU.
cases.expected: Greet Noor, introduce the assistant and suggest relevant help. No unsolicited plan or cannot-verify fallback.

cases.title: Second-year introduction repeated
turns: Hi, my name is Noor. I am an IT major in my second year, second semester at UAEU.
Hi, my name is Noor. I am an IT major in my second year, second semester at UAEU.
cases.expected: Natural greeting/acknowledgement on each turn; no unsolicited plan, old college name, raw XML citation or cannot-verify fallback.

cases.title: Next semester using earlier IT year and semester
turns: Hi, my name is Noor. I am an IT major in my second year, second semester at UAEU.
What should I take next semester?
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
cases.expected: Keep IT as the only stated program and infer Year 3 Semester 1. Ask for admit term/catalog if unknown, then use that matching official plan. Do not invent Information Security as an earlier-mentioned program.
